item.title: Senate GOP moves 97 Trump nominees closer to historic milestone
item.description: Senate Republicans teed up another massive batch of President Donald Trump's nominees for confirmation as they sprint to finish out a busy year in the upper chamber.

item.title: House Passes GOP Health Care Bill Without Obamacare Subsidy Extension
item.description: Some House Republicans pushed for a short-term extension of Obamacare's enhanced premium tax credits in addition to the market reforms included in the bill.
